deleteCypressUsers.title: Delete test accounts
deleteCypressUsers.description: Permanently deletes all automated-test (Cypress) accounts matching a cypress@chayn.co email, including their database records and related data, and their Firebase, Front and Mailchimp profiles. Use this to clear test data that has leaked into an environment.
deleteCypressUsers.warning: This is a hard delete and cannot be undone.
deleteCypressUsers.confirmLabel: I understand this permanently deletes these accounts and all their data.

syncFrontContacts.title: Sync Front contacts
syncFrontContacts.description: Re-sends every custom field to Front for all contacts — everyone imported from Crisp plus everyone who has signed up since. Repairs contacts whose sign up and last active dates show as 01/01/1970. Safe to run more than once.
syncFrontContacts.counting: Checking how many contacts need syncing…
syncFrontContacts.coverage: {count} contacts will be synced, covering everyone from {since} onwards.
syncFrontContacts.failed: Stopped after an error. {processed} of {total} contacts processed.
syncFrontContacts.breakdown: {updated} updated · {notFound} no longer in Front · {skipped} test accounts skipped · {failed} failed
